original_value: With the rapid development of the computer network technology, the blended learning method based on computer-assisted teaching has also been booming. This paper analyzes the connotations of blended learning and the architecture and main functions of the Moodle system by using research methods such as litera-ture analysis, development and research method and sample survey method and then establishes a blended learning model based on the Moodle platform. Then, with the course of C Programming Language as an example, this paper gives de-tailed design of the process and implementation plan of the blended learning model based on the Moodle platform. At last, this paper investigates and analyzes the teaching effects among teachers and students participating in the learning ac-tivity, and the results show that the blended learning model based on the Moodle platform is helpful to improving the teaching effects and can serve as a reference for the innovation of teaching models and methods.

result.paraphrase: With the rapid advancement of computer network technology, blended learning based on computer-assisted instruction has also been developing rapidly. This paper examines the meaning of blended learning and the structure and primary functions of the Moodle system using literature analysis, development and research methods, and sample survey methods, and then builds a blended learning model based on the Moodle platform. Taking the C Programming Language course as an example, it provides a detailed design of the process and implementation plan for the Moodle-based blended learning model. Finally, the paper investigates and analyzes the teaching outcomes among teachers and students involved in the learning activity, and the results indicate that the Moodle-platform-based blended learning model helps improve teaching effectiveness and can offer a reference for innovating teaching models and methods.
